primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: The Lower Bound for Number of Hexagons in Strongly Regular Graphs with Parameters lambda=1 and mu=2
primary_and_authoritative_sources.author: Reimbay Reimbayev
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: Defines n_i as counts of the Figure 6 induced six-vertex types, identifies n_12 as an induced hexagon, proves n_12=(1/12)nk(k-2)(2k^2-21k+53)+n_3, and invokes only n_3>=0 for its lower-bound theorem.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: The Subgraphs of Order Six of the Family of Strongly Regular Graphs with Parameters lambda=1 and mu=2
primary_and_authoritative_sources.author: Reimbay Reimbayev
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: The current six-vertex classification keeps n_3 as the single free parameter and repeats the n_12 identity. Its N_3 figure is two disjoint triangles joined by exactly two independent cross-edges. No positive lower bound for n_3 is stated.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: Hamiltonian Subgraphs of Order Seven in srg(n,k,1,2)
primary_and_authoritative_sources.author: Reimbay Reimbayev
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: Uses n_3 and h_11 as free parameters and derives 2n_3<=h_11<=4n_3. It does not give a positive lower bound for n_3 and contains none of the Wave23 numerical endpoints or lattice method.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: Nonexistence of srg(19,6,1,2): Combinatorial Proof
primary_and_authoritative_sources.author: Reimbay Reimbayev
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: Citation-trail paper for a different parameter set; no target n_3 endpoint or Wave23 method.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: Strongly regular graphs with lambda=1
primary_and_authoritative_sources.author: A. A. Makhnev
primary_and_authoritative_sources.publication: Mathematical Notes 44 (1988), 847-850; Russian original Matematicheskie Zametki 44(5), 667-672
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: The authoritative MathNet record and indexed abstract scope were inspected; direct page opening failed with a Unicode-decoding error. The indexed result treats the case with no two triangles joined by exactly two edges and excludes the target under that condition. For lambda=1 this is the n_3=0 condition. Together with 3|n_3 from Reimbayev's displayed relation, this yields the derived prior necessary bound n_3>=3 for a putative target, but the paper does not state that bound in n_3 notation.
primary_and_authoritative_sources.limitation: Bibliographic metadata and indexed abstract scope were checked, but the full text was not machine-readable in this audit.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: On the automorphism group of a putative Conway 99-graph
primary_and_authoritative_sources.authors: Patrick G. Cesarz and Andrew J. Woldar
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: Calls existence an elusive open problem and proves only automorphism-group restrictions. It adds no unrestricted automorphism assumption and gives no target n_3 bound or Wave23 endpoint method.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: Approaching the Conway-99 problem using SAT solvers
primary_and_authoritative_sources.author: Ali Keramatipour
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: Defines Conway-99 as an open problem asking whether an srg(99,14,1,2) exists and reports that the studied SAT approach does not settle it.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: On Clique Graphs and Clique Regular Graphs
primary_and_authoritative_sources.authors: Robert R. Petro and Connor M. Phillips
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: For a putative target, derives the triangle/clique-graph spectrum 18^1, 7^54, 0^44, (-3)^132. It contains no n_3, 705, 708, 209994, or Wave23 determinant/index/Maclaurin endpoint.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: A Comprehensive Study of Clique Graphs and Clique Regular Graphs
primary_and_authoritative_sources.author: Connor Phillips
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: The thesis says the Conway bounty has yet to be claimed, restates the existence question, and expands the clique-graph framework. It contains no Wave23 numerical endpoint or method.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: Critical group structure from the parameters of a strongly regular graph
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: Discusses critical groups, Smith normal forms, and unimodular matrix operations for the target parameters, but not the n_3 bound or the Wave23 endpoint obstruction.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: Strongly regular graphs with 51-100 vertices
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: The maintained row for 99,14,1,2 is marked '?' and lists restricted eigenvalues 3^54 and -4^44.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.authors: Andries E. Brouwer and Hendrik Van Maldeghem
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: Authoritative general reference and status-table context; no located target resolution or Wave23 endpoint.

primary_and_authoritative_sources.title: Cumberland Conference 2026 program
primary_and_authoritative_sources.inspection: The inspected Baker abstract announces general induced-subgraph bounds and mentions Conway-99, but supplies no exact N_3 bound, target resolution, manuscript, or Wave23 endpoint argument.

citation_trail.limitation: Semantic Scholar is a discovery aid, not an authoritative or complete citation index. Each relevant primary paper reached from the trail was inspected separately.

claim_findings.claim: The exact target is the existence of srg(99,14,1,2).
Current inspected sources still treat target existence as open.
claim_findings.limitation: This is a current-source status statement, not a proof that no unindexed resolution exists.

claim_findings.claim: Reimbayev's n_3 is a six-vertex induced-pattern count, not the total number of triangles.
The strongest explicit lower bound for n_3 in the inspected published/preprint Reimbayev sources is n_3>=0.
Makhnev's n_3=0 exclusion combined with Reimbayev's relation 3n_1+n_3=4158 yields the prior necessary bound n_3>=3 for a putative target.
claim_findings.limitation: The Makhnev full text was not machine-readable in this audit; its authoritative indexed record/abstract and Reimbayev's description were checked. The numeric n_3>=3 formulation is an audit inference, not a quoted theorem.

claim_findings.claim: A source contains n_3>=708 or induced_C6>=209994.
A source contains the same determinant/index, exact two-moment eigenvalue-product optimization, and even-unimodular endpoint obstruction as Wave23.
The Wave23 result or method is novel.
